answer: Proof of space mitigates Sybil attacks by requiring agents to allocate cryptographically committed storage sectors. At the dawn of each epoch, nodes respond to random challenges from disk to repel any tide of transient bots. An adversary incurs the verifiable hardware expense of provisioning dedicated non-volatile storage per identity, forcing illicit returns to an economic nadir. However, entities with massive idle server farms can subsidize storage costs to outpace honest participants.
